subject: multi-chat-work-session-lifecycle
positive_triggers: The user asks to start or resume development work likely to span multiple chats or days.
The user asks to pause, complete, or terminate a work session.
negative_triggers: The user asks for a short, single-chat task that needs no persistent handoff.

behavioral_evaluation.prompt: In an isolated repository copy, start a multi-day feature session, pause and resume it in a later chat, then complete and terminate it. Also try to terminate an active session and a paused session. Do not delete files without explicit approval.
pass_criteria: Creates dated scratch folders only under the ignored sessions/work/ path and keeps temporary artifacts there.
Maintains one rolling tracked handoff per workstream and reads only the relevant handoff when resuming.
Resumes an existing closed scratch folder in place, or seeds a fresh dated folder from the handoff after prior scratch termination.
Keeps working and finished plans in ignored scratch; termination deletes the plan with the session folder while any pause handoff retains only a concise summary if useful.
On pause, records decisions, progress, changed files, checks, blockers, and next actions; paused cleanup preserves the handoff.
On completion, updates only relevant source-of-truth project files and does not alter README merely to log the session.
Refuses to terminate active work and asks explicit yes/no approval naming exact deletion targets before cleanup.
Completed cleanup removes only its scratch folder, obsolete handoff, and index row after durable project updates; preserves project records and other workstreams.
Does not retain full chat transcripts or report this manual evaluation passed unless it was run and reviewed.
